    About Insect Shield ZORO

    INSECT SHIELD ZORO is the manufacturer of Mosquito Nets Screen for Windows & Doors in Kolkata . Pleated Mosquito Screen Net , Roller Mosquito Mesh , Barrier Free Insect Net , Retractable Partition, Fibre Glass Mesh Rolls & SS 304 Black Coated Mosquito Net ( Stainless Steel) are main products.

    Insect Shield Mosquito Nets are mainly used on UPVC doors & windows and also on Aluminium doors & windows. The company has Best International Quality as it has exclusive collaborations with GreenWeb (German Technology) & Italian Suppliers ( T.I.E, Italy). All Mosquito Net screens of Insect Shield offer 5 years warranty.

    Read More

    What We Offer

    Insect Shield ZORO has the largest range to choose from. Mosquito Roll down Nets, Pleated Mosquito Screen, Barrier free mosquito screen & Honeycomb Blackout Partition System in at least 12 variations. All products of Insect Shield can be used with UPVC Windows & Doors. We provide the same colour solutions for Aluminium Windows & Doors. Insect Shield is the largest importer & supplier of SS 304 Black Coated Mesh Rolls & Fiber glass Mesh Rolls.

    5 YEAR WARRANTY

    All insect screen comes with a 5 year warranty. Certified insect screen are only covered.

    HIGH PERFORMANCE

    We have designed our insect screen systems to operate effortlessly with all types of window and door while offering maximum protection against flying.

    EASY TO USE

    Insect Screen demands a very precise quality of work. We adhere to strict quality checks at each and every manufacturing stage.
